nodes.name: Sklearn Multiclass Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level OneVsRestClassifier, OneVsOneClassifier, and OutputCodeClassifier selection, callback-payload, and fitted-state atoms above cloned-estimator, response-method, joblib, code-book, and metadata-routing boundaries.

nodes.name: multiclass_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public sklearn multiclass meta-estimator names useful for framework-level selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: multiclass_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return the multiclass family represented by a public estimator name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a dictionary lookup over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: multiclass_estimator_boundary
nodes.description: Return the cloned-estimator, response-method, or code-book callback boundary represented by a public multiclass estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: multiclass_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level multiclass routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered multiclass estimator.

nodes.name: multiclass_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public multiclass fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing cloned-estimator callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, fit_params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and packages references without fitting cloned estimators.

nodes.name: multiclass_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public multiclass prediction-like payload without executing estimator response callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving response methods and decoding to sklearn.

nodes.name: multiclass_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public multiclass estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: multiclass_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted class, delegate-estimator, pairwise-index, and code-book metadata after delegated multiclass execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes already-fitted class labels and delegate estimator counts proportional to class count.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 3 public multiclass meta-estimator shells over cloned-estimator, response-method, metadata-routing, and code-book callback boundaries
limitations: Base estimators, response methods, metadata routing, joblib scheduling, one-vs-one pair fitting, one-vs-rest binary fitting, and output-code response decoding remain delegated behavior.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not cloned-estimator training, prediction, probability, decision-function, score, partial-fit, or metadata-routing execution.
